label: Vatican City named the holy city in a third temple negotiation
description: A negotiation covering the third temple in which the Vatican is named as the holy city, with the Catholic Church said to be losing relevance and regaining it by creating a stir there. Given 6 December 2025.

label: Blisters on hands and mouths in New York, and a hospital ship
description: Blister-like marks on the hands and mouths of people in New York, with hospitals full and patients flown by helicopter to a large ship docked outside the city. Given 4 December 2025.

label: A man in great pain who was president a couple of months ago
description: A man seen leaning over in great pain looking out of a cold window, who he says was president only a couple of months earlier. Given 4 December 2025.
aliases: he was in so much pain
a couple of months ago he was president

label: The major banks adopt crypto as a lending platform
description: Bank of America adopting crypto legislation to run lending platforms, with Wells Fargo, Chase and other major banks following. Given 3 December 2025.
